passages.text: The following discussion and analysis should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and the notes thereto. We prepared our consolidated financial statements in accordance with GAAP. Additional sections in this report which should be helpful to the reading of our discussion and analysis include the following: (i) a description of our business strategy found in Items 1 and 2. “ Business and Properties—Narrative Description of Business—Business Strategy; ” (ii) a description of developments during 2025, found in Items 1 and 2. “ Business and Properties—General Development of Business—Recent Developments; ” (iii) a description of terms for services and commodities we provide, found in Items 1 and 2. “Business and Properties—Narrative Description of Business—Business Segments;” (iv) a description of risk factors affecting us and our business, found in Item 1A. “ Risk Factors; ” and (v) a discussion of forward-looking statements, found in “ Information Regarding Forward-Looking Statements ” at the beginning of this report. A comparative discussion of our 2024 to 2023 operating results can be found in Item 7. “ Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations—Results of Operations ” included in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024 filed with the SEC on February 13, 2025. General Acquisition and Divestiture Following are an acquisition and a divestiture we made during the 2025 reporting period. See Note 3 “Acquisitions and Divestitures” to our consolidated financial statements for further information on these transactions. Event Description Business Segment EagleHawk divestiture $382 million (December 2025) We sold our 25% equity interest in EagleHawk. Natural Gas Pipelines (Midstream) Outrigger Energy acquisition $648 million (February 2025) Natural gas gathering and processing system in North Dakota from Outrigger Energy II LLC which includes a 0.27 Bcf/d processing facility and a 104-mile, large-diameter, high-pressure rich gas gathering header pipeline with 0.35 Bcf/d of capacity connecting supplies from the Williston Basin area to high-demand markets. Natural Gas Pipelines (Midstream) 2026 Dividends and Discretionary Capital We expect to declare dividends of $1.19 per share for 2026, a 2% increase from the 2025 declared dividends of $1.17 per share. The expectations for 2026 discussed above involve risks, uncertainties and assumptions, and are not guarantees of performance. Critical Accounting Estimates Critical accounting estimates and assumptions involve material levels of subjectivity and complex judgment to account for highly uncertain matters or matters with a high susceptibility to change, and could result in a material impact to our financial statements. Examples of certain areas that require more judgment relative to others when preparing our consolidated financial statements and related disclosures include our use of estimates in determining (i) revenue recognition; (ii) income taxes; (iii) the economic useful lives of our assets and related depreciation and depletion rates; (iv) the fair values used in (a) assignment of the purchase price for a business acquisition, (b) calculations of possible asset and equity investment impairment charges, (c) calculation for the annual goodwill impairment test (or interim tests if triggered), and (d) recording derivative contract assets and liabilities; (v) reserves for environmental claims, legal fees, transportation rate cases, and other litigation liabilities; (vi) provisions for credit losses; and (vii) exposures under contractual indemnifications. We routinely evaluate these estimates, utilizing historical experience, consultation with experts and other methods we consider reasonable in the particular circumstances. Nevertheless, actual results may differ significantly from our estimates, and any effects on our business, financial position or results of operations resulting from revisions to these estimates are recorded in the period in which the facts that give rise to the revision become known. For a summary of our significant accounting policies, see Note 2 “Summary of Significant Accounting Policies” to our consolidated financial statements and the following discussion for further information regarding critical accounting estimates and assumptions used in the preparation of our financial statements. For discussion on our hedging activities and related sensitivities to our estimates, see Note 13 “Risk Management” to our consolidated financial statements and Item 7A. “ Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk ,” respectively. Impairments In addition to our annual goodwill impairment testing, we evaluate our goodwill, long-lived assets, and equity method investments for impairment whenever events or changes in circumstances indicate that their carrying amounts may not be recoverable. Management applies judgment in assessing whether such triggering events have occurred. Impairment testing requires estimating fair value, which involves the use of significant estimates and assumptions regarding the timing and amounts of future cash inflows and outflows, commodity prices, discount rates, market multiples, and asset lives, among other items and as applicable. These estimates can be affected by a variety of factors, including external factors such as industry and macroeconomic conditions, and internal factors such as changes in our business strategy and our internal forecasts. credit_strengths.text: KMI's operating margin exceeds the sector median, reflecting the fee-based nature of its natural gas transmission and midstream assets. Operating income has grown steadily over the past three years, and the Outrigger Energy acquisition expands gathering and processing capacity in the Williston Basin, supporting future revenue growth.

Operating cash flow covers capital expenditures and dividends, leaving positive free cash flow. The company generated solid operating cash flow, which after capex still leaves a substantial surplus. This internally funded model reduces reliance on external debt for routine capital needs and supports the current dividend.

key_risks.text: KMI's debt note shows a large concentration of maturities beyond year five, but near-term maturities include a substantial current portion. The company also has a credit facility and commercial paper borrowings, which introduce refinancing risk if market conditions tighten. The debt structure relies on continued access to capital markets.

The risk factors highlight significant judgment in impairment testing for goodwill, long-lived assets, and equity method investments. Estimates of future cash flows, commodity prices, and discount rates could change, potentially leading to material impairment charges. This is a concrete risk given the capital-intensive nature of the business.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is slightly above the sector median, but remains modest. With operating income covering interest expense at a low multiple, the company has limited headroom to absorb earnings volatility. A decline in operating income could pressure coverage, though the fee-based business model provides some stability.

Free cash flow to debt is positive and above the sector median, indicating better internal debt repayment capacity than peers. However, the ratio remains low in absolute terms, meaning debt reduction from free cash flow alone would be slow. The company relies on refinancing and capital markets access to manage maturities.

overall_credit_view.text: KMI's leverage sits below the sector median, but the indicative financial risk profile is aggressive. The company's debt burden is substantial, and the Altman Z-score falls in the distress zone, suggesting elevated financial risk. However, the stable, fee-based cash flows from natural gas transmission provide some offset.

The company's shareholder return policy absorbs a significant portion of free cash flow, with dividends exceeding free cash flow. This limits deleveraging capacity and increases reliance on debt refinancing. While the dividend is expected to grow modestly, the payout constrains financial flexibility and could pressure credit metrics if cash flows decline.

credit_strengths.text: KMI的營運利潤率高於行業中位數，反映其天然氣輸送及中游資產以費用為基礎的性質。營運收入在過去三年穩步增長，而收購Outrigger Energy擴大了Williston盆地的集輸及處理能力，支持未來收入增長。
營運現金流覆蓋資本開支及股息，留下正自由現金流。公司產生穩健的營運現金流，扣除資本開支後仍留下可觀盈餘。這種內部融資模式減少了對外部債務的依賴以應付日常資本需求，並支持當前股息。

key_risks.text: KMI的債務票據顯示大部分到期日集中在五年以後，但近期到期債務包括一筆可觀的流動部分。公司亦有信貸融資及商業票據借款，若市場條件收緊，將引入再融資風險。債務結構依賴持續進入資本市場。
風險因素凸顯在商譽、長期資產及權益法投資的減值測試中存在重大判斷。未來現金流、商品價格及貼現率的估計可能改變，可能導致重大減值費用。鑑於業務屬資本密集型，這是一項具體風險。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率略高於行業中位數，但仍屬溫和。營運收入以低倍數覆蓋利息支出，公司吸納盈利波動的空間有限。營運收入下降可能對覆蓋率構成壓力，儘管以費用為基礎的業務模式提供一定穩定性。
自由現金流對債務比率為正且高於行業中位數，表明內部償債能力優於同業。然而，該比率絕對值仍然偏低，意味僅靠自由現金流減少債務將進展緩慢。公司依賴再融資及進入資本市場來管理到期債務。

overall_credit_view.text: KMI的槓桿低於行業中位數，但指示性財務風險狀況為進取。公司的債務負擔龐大，而Altman Z-score落入困境區域，顯示財務風險偏高。然而，天然氣輸送穩定、以費用為基礎的現金流提供一定抵銷。
公司的股東回報政策吸收相當部分自由現金流，股息超過自由現金流。這限制了去槓桿能力，並增加對債務再融資的依賴。雖然股息預計溫和增長，但派息限制了財務靈活性，若現金流下降，可能對信用指標構成壓力。
